items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: Herschel Evans died, and he called Buddy Tate to take his place.

ctx.x: It was during that time, in the late thirties, '38 or '39, somewhere around there, that Count Basie had a misfortune with one of his famous saxophonists. Herschel Evans died, and he called Buddy Tate to take his place.
